text:
tara: Quick favor — can someone run a tiny-batch microbench across A100 / H100 / L40S? I want a direct compare batch=1 vs batch=8, seq total=4096 (2k prompt + 2k gen). Warm vs cold KV cache. p50/p95/p99 + throughput. Low priority but would like numbers before Wednesday.

alex: I can take a stab today. Which model + precision? continuous batching on or off?

tara: Use rw-7b fp16, no quant. Run both continuous batching enabled and disabled. Warm = run a single warmup iteration then measure; cold = first-run metric. Include CUDA/driver info in the logs.

jason: FYI L40S harness lives in /bench/hw/l40s/smallbatch — I can kick that off. Do you want 2k gen per request or something else?

tara: Yes 2k gen per request (so prompt 2k + gen 2k = 4k). Keep batch sizes exactly 1 and 8. Also collect p50/p95/p99 token latency and tokens/sec.

alex: I'll run with this command (small snippet):

```bash
python bench/run_dist.py --model rw-7b --precision fp16 --seq-total 4096 \
  --gen-tokens 2048 --batch 1 --continuous-batching on --warmup 1 --out results/a100_b1_cont.csv
```

alex: I'll run batch=8 + continuous off too and upload csvs.

ci-bot: deploy-bench-runner: started job bnr-1876543 on a100-1 (ETA ~30m) :rocket: 

jason: Started L40S and H100 now. Noted an H100 kernel fallback on the second run — capturing dmesg and perf. Might be a driver mismatch.

tara: If you hit fallback on H100, capture the fallback trace and perf counters. Tag @maria for regression triage.

maria: On it. If H100 shows fallback, try `--lkernel on` and a small reproduce slice (batch=1, seq=512) to get deterministic traces.

alex: Great. I'll post raw csvs + a one-paragraph summary with the p99 deltas and tokens/sec per-sku back in this thread when done. cc @jason

ci-bot: deploy-bench-runner: job bnr-1876543 completed on a100-1, artifacts: http://ci.internal/bench/1876543 :white_check_mark: 

tara: Perfect — thanks everyone. Ping me here when you have the p99 deltas. If clean, we'll include in next runtime sync and doc the recommended default batch/continuous settings per SKU.
